evals.prompt: which of the scraped gtx laptops are actually good deals right now? i want min 16gb ram, and tell me why each one is cheap - dont want broken stuff unless its really cheap
evals.expected_output: A short ranked list of underpriced relevant laptops with >=16GB RAM, each with link, price, comparison group median and ratio, group size, and caveats read from the description (damage, for parts). Mentions sample-size limits.

evals.prompt: how much more do 16GB laptops cost vs 8GB ones in my gtx-laptops search? also which GPUs show up the most and is RTX 3050 worth the extra money compared to gtx 1650?
evals.expected_output: Median (and n) price by RAM group and by GPU, GPU value counts, and an honest answer on RTX 3050 vs GTX 1650: if the data has no (or too few) RTX 3050 offers, it says so instead of inventing a comparison. Caveats about sample sizes and excluded offers.

evals.prompt: quick sanity check of my scrappy data before i rely on it: did the last runs work, are attributes extracted for everything, which fields are often empty, and did any prices drop?
evals.expected_output: Run status summary, extraction coverage (done/pending/failed), per-attribute null rates, list of price drops with old->new values, and concrete next steps for any problem found.
